info.title: agent 0.2.0-alpha.2 — Git-native consistency manager for AI-agent skills.
info.description: Git extension for Agent Sync. Installing this .NET tool globally puts `git-agent` on PATH so `git agent <command>` behaves exactly like `agent <command>`. See the AgentSync package for the primary `agent` CLI.
